title: List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respect
question:
List the names of virtual schools that are among the top 5 in their respective counties based on average reading scores.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Exclusively virtual refers to Virtual = 'F'; respective counties means PARTITION BY County

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT s.XCL_042
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.XCL_041 = ss.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_045 = 'Virtual'
  AND s.XCL_041 IN (
    SELECT s2.XCL_041
    FROM schools s2
    JOIN satscores ss2 ON s2.XCL_041 = ss2.XCL_030
    WHERE s2.XCL_045 = 'Virtual'
    GROUP BY s2.XCL_041
    ORDER BY ss2.XCL_037 DESC
    LIMIT 5
  )

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT s.XCL_047 AS name,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.XCL_045 ORDER BY AVG(t.XCL_038) DESC) AS rn
  FROM schools s
  JOIN satscores t ON t.XCL_030 = s.XCL_041
  WHERE s.XCL_076 = 'F'
  GROUP BY s.XCL_041
)
SELECT name FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5
